This activity affects cardholders by draining funds through rapid micro-bursts of spending. It was found via Sentinel sweeps identifying near-threshold transaction patterns.

case.summary: Case SEN-015 was opened on 2016-11-24 following a Sentinel sweep on card C10751-K1 belonging to customer C10751. The investigation revealed four online purchases made within 21 minutes, each structured just under the $500 authorization threshold for a total exposure of $1,906.11. With a fraud probability of 0.90, the verdict is confirmed as fraud. Recommended actions include blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a report.

sar.narrative: Customer C10751 utilizing card C10751-K1 was identified in a suspicious transaction pattern involving unauthorized online activity. A series of four fraudulent online purchases totaling $1,906.11 was executed across the affected account. The activity occurred on 2016-11-24 between 17:00:00 and 17:21:00. Transactions were conducted via online channels from specific regional and device profiles. The perpetrator utilized structured amounts just under the $500 threshold to evade immediate authorization blocks. This activity is highly suspicious due to the rapid succession of near-limit transactions and the deployment of new device profiles. No connected cards were identified in this specific incident. Recommended actions include blocking the card and filing a regulatory report.
